description: Searches published wedding vendors by category, location and price range. Results include business details and listing links, with totals and pagination; summary omits descriptions and images. Each result states whether its content was generated by Aisle from public information or is managed by the vendor, where its rating comes from, whether its category was chosen by the vendor or assigned by Aisle’s search, and the domain of its website. A price band is reported, and matched by the price filter, only when the vendor supplied it. Results can be filtered by minimum Google rating and review count, and ordered by name, rating or review count. When a location holds fewer than five matching vendors, the result lists nearby locations within 150km that hold more, with counts and distances. A location search also gives each vendor’s distance from the middle of that location’s listings, since the listed city is the place searched rather than the vendor’s own town. Vendors in the same category and location that share a website or phone number are named on each other’s results as possible duplicates. This search does not check live availability or make bookings.

category.description: Vendor category filter, fuzzy-matched. One of: photographer, videographer, florist, caterer, dj, band, planner, coordinator, hair_makeup, cake_bakery, officiant, rentals_decor, stationery, transportation.

min_rating.description: Only vendors with at least this Google rating, out of 5. Unrated vendors are left out.

min_reviews.description: Only vendors with at least this many Google reviews.

offset.description: Number of results to skip; nextOffset from the previous page continues the result set.

price_range.description: Price range filter: $ (budget) to $$$$ (luxury). Matches only listings whose vendor gave a band; generated listings have none.

sort.description: Result order: name (default), rating (highest first, ties broken by review count) or reviews (most reviewed first).

summary.description: Return compact comparison fields without descriptions and images (default false).

name: search_vendors
title: Search Wedding Vendors
